summary: Frontend-only regression test of the new payment-method DropdownMenu on /admin/students/{id}?tab=invoices. Verified (a) the 'Neue Rechnung' Zahlungsweise field (invoice-new-payment-method) renders as a button with coloured dot + label + ChevronDown and opens a dropdown with exactly 4 options (bar/rechnung/kreditkarte/twint) — labels 'Bar', 'Rechnung', 'Kreditkarte', 'Twint' — with a green Check icon on the current selection that follows the selected value; (b) each existing row shows the same pattern with testid invoice-payment-method-{id} and invoice-payment-method-{id}-option-{k}; (c) clicking the SAME payment method on a row fires 0 PATCH (idempotent); (d) clicking a DIFFERENT method fires exactly one PATCH /api/students/{sid}/invoices/{iid} with the new payment_method in the body and updates the trigger label inline without page reload; (e) no horizontal scroll at 1440x900 or 768x900 and all row action buttons (PDF, E-Mail, Delete) remain visible; (f) at 1024px the 4 Neue-Rechnung row-1 fields align on a single grid row. Seed data restored (RE-2026-0001 back to twint, RE-2026-0044 untouched at kreditkarte).
critical_code_review_comments: InvoicesTab.jsx L441 row option onClick uses idempotency guard `k !== inv.payment_method && patch(...)` — confirmed no PATCH on same-method click.
New-form option onClick (L292) does not need an idempotency guard since it only mutates local draft state — behaviour is correct.

Both DropdownMenuTrigger children have data-testids on the underlying button (invoice-new-payment-method and invoice-payment-method-{id}); options carry stable testids on DropdownMenuItem — good for automated tests.
PAYMENT_META dots verified: bar=#84cc16 (green), rechnung=#0ea5e9 (blue), kreditkarte=#8b5cf6 (purple), twint=#0f172a (near-black). Matches the spec.
Row-2 Status pill (invoice-status-{id}) remains a shadcn DropdownMenu — unchanged from iteration 47, no regression.
seed_data_creation: None. RE-2026-0001 payment_method was toggled twint -> bar (PATCH 1) then restored to twint (PATCH 2). Both PATCHes were network-observed. RE-2026-0044 was not modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 48 verified invoice payment-method DropdownMenu on Stefan Haas (student 443c0166-8f6e-4274-8c6a-9dfd6cc27e27). Seeds are intact: RE-2026-0001 (open, twint) and RE-2026-0044 (paid, kreditkarte). DropdownMenu content is portaled to body — option testids only exist after clicking the trigger. Trigger label is plain-cased (no CSS uppercase), so direct text.lower() checks against 'bar/rechnung/kreditkarte/twint' work fine. Status dropdown behavior (iteration 47) also still passes visually.
